summary: Celulosa Arauco y Constitución S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its board's decision to call an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting on September 10, 2026, to approve an equity support agreement (ESA) with parent Empresas Copec S.A. Empresas Copec commits to keep available up to US$450 million, drawable from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028, contingent on triggering events. Arauco would pay a 0.3% annual availability fee on the undisbursed balance. Given the related-party nature, directors abstained. EY Consultores Limitada was appointed as independent appraiser. This is a parent-company liquidity backstop, not a standalone special-situation category; watch the shareholder vote outcome and any triggering events.
